title: N0BADYS RESOURCE PACK
description: This resource pack gives you a vanilla feeling with some modifications
body:
PvP resource pack with low fire and short swords for better visibility. Campfire smoke removed for cleaner fights and you get a better visibility with a pumpkin on the head. Everything else stays in a smooth vanilla style for a classic feel.

✨ Features:

• Low fire & short swords for better visibility
• Decreasd particals for smoother gameplay
• Better visibility with a pumpkin on the head
